evidence.observation: Growth begins at 3.04 Torr, matching prior stages
Pressure rises monotonically 3.04→3.33 Torr over ~12 min at constant Ar flow and temperature
Ar flow steady at ~100 sccm, so the rise is not a flow change
Thermocouple stable at 750 °C with steady heater power ~46%, so no thermal cause
Exhaust O2 sensor not installed; atmosphere integrity cannot be verified

args.missing_evidence: An exhaust O2 reading (or a flow-step/pump-isolation test) to distinguish an air in-leak from a downstream exhaust restriction; O2 is not installed, so a deliberate Ar setpoint step and observation of the pressure response is the available discriminator.
